risks: Z1 is in development. Key risks include component availability, production consistency, and international shipping. We have completed multiple prototype and sample-testing rounds, and will conduct production validation and quality-control checks before shipment. If the schedule or specifications change, we will update backers promptly through Kickstarter.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Why is the price shown on Kickstarter different from the advertised price?
faq.a: Our advertised prices are listed in US dollars (USD), while prices on Kickstarter are displayed in Singapore dollars (SGD). Since the currencies are different, the amounts shown may look different, but the actual price is equivalent after currency conversion.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | How do I claim my exclusive VIP benefits?
faq.a:
Once our Kickstarter campaign launches, we'll send an exclusive pledge link to the email address you used for your VIP reservation.
Simply follow the link to our campaign page, select your preferred Z1 reward package, and complete your pledge to enjoy the exclusive $99 VIP price and other reservation benefits.
Please note that the $1 reservation deposit only secures your VIP eligibility and does not count as a completed purchase. You'll still need to complete your pledge on Kickstarter.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | What does the $1 reservation deposit unlock?
faq.a: Reserve your VIP spot with just a $1 deposit to unlock the exclusive $99 VIP price, saving $90 off the $189 suggested retail price. You'll also enjoy priority shipping and an additional year of extended warranty coverage.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Will my $1 VIP reservation deposit be refunded?
faq.a: Yes. Once you complete the $99 pledge payment, the $1 deposit you previously paid will be refunded. Even if you do not proceed with a pledge during the campaign, your $1 deposit will still be refunded.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | What should I do if my Kickstarter account email is different from my VIP reservation email?
faq.a: If your Kickstarter account email is different from your VIP reservation email, please contact the CYBERSIGHT support team as soon as possible at support@cybersight.sg and provide your reservation deposit order number so we can update your information and send you the pledge link.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Is there an expiration date for my VIP pricing eligibility?
faq.a: We have reserved a generous window for you. You simply need to complete your pledge before the crowdfunding campaign ends.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | How can I claim my VIP benefits if I made multiple reservations using different email addresses?
faq.a:
Each $1 VIP reservation comes with an exclusive purchase link, and each Kickstarter account can redeem VIP benefits through only one such link.
If you made multiple VIP reservations using different email addresses, you'll need to use a separate Kickstarter account matching each reservation email to complete your pledges. This ensures that each reservation qualifies for the exclusive $99 VIP price and associated benefits.

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | When will Kickstarter charge my pledge?
faq.a: You won’t be charged immediately when you back our project. Kickstarter will automatically charge your payment method after the campaign ends, provided we’ve reached our funding goal. If the campaign doesn’t reach its goal, you won’t be charged.

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | What payment methods does Kickstarter accept?
faq.a: Kickstarter accepts major credit and debit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Discover, UnionPay, and JCB are accepted only for US-based projects. PayPal is not supported. Please check the payment options shown at checkout.

faq.q: Payments & Pledges | Can I cancel my pledge after backing Z1?
faq.a:
Yes. While the Kickstarter campaign is live, you can visit the CYBERSIGHT Z1 campaign page, click “Manage your pledge”, and then select “Cancel Pledge.”
Please note:
During the final 24 hours of the campaign, you cannot cancel your pledge if doing so would cause the project's funding total to fall below its goal.
Once the campaign has ended and payment collection has begun, you can no longer cancel your pledge through Kickstarter. If you would like to request a refund, please email us at support…

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | What should I do if my payment fails after the campaign ends?
faq.a:
Log in to Kickstarter and click “Fix Payment,” or use the link in the payment failure email from Kickstarter. Follow the instructions to retry your payment or use a different card. If the payment still fails, please contact your bank or card issuer for assistance.
You have 7 days after the campaign ends to resolve a failed pledge payment.
For more details, please visit the https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236451-a-project-i-m-backing-just-succeeded-but-my-pledge-was-declined-what-do…

faq.q: Rewards & Add-ons | How do I select my rewards and add-ons?
faq.a: In the second step of the pledge process, you can select your rewards and add-ons, such as prescription sports lenses, a prescription lens insert, and interchangeable lenses.

faq.q: Rewards & Add-ons | Can I change my reward or add accessories during the campaign?
faq.a: You can change to an available reward or add any add-ons offered during the live campaign. Sign in to Kickstarter, open the project page, and select Manage your pledge, then Change your pledge. Review and confirm your changes. Contact our team for requests after the campaign ends.

faq.q: Rewards & Add-ons | Does the base price include prescription lenses or an Rx lens insert?
faq.a:
The base package includes an Rx insert frame fitted with non-prescription (plano) lenses, but custom prescription lenses are not included.
If you need custom prescription lenses, you can purchase either integrated prescription sport lenses or custom prescription lenses for the included Rx insert at an additional cost. Pricing varies depending on your chosen lens option. Please refer to the final reward tiers and add-on details on our Kickstarter campaign page for specific pricing.

faq.q: Rewards & Add-ons | When and how can I choose my frame and lens colors?
faq.a: Backers at all reward tiers will be able to select their frame and lens colors through our official survey system after the campaign successfully ends.
